sources.title: Djibouti eVisa guidance
sources.publisher: National Agency for State Information Systems, Republic of Djibouti
sources.officialityEvidence: The live state eVisa information has no Singapore ordinary-passport eligibility schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Il remplace le visa délivré au point d'entrée dans le pays.

sources.title: Liberia Visa on Arrival service
sources.officialityEvidence: The live service conditions its route on whether a Liberian embassy is in the traveller's country, rather than a Singapore-passport result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: If there is a Liberian embassy in your country, you are required to apply for your visa directly at the embassy.

sources.title: Sierra Leone eVisa service
sources.publisher: Sierra Leone Immigration Department eVisa service
sources.officialityEvidence: Sierra Leone Immigration Department's live slid.gov.sl page links www.evisa.sl as its 'Official Portal.' The live eVisa language has airport/border issuance wording and no Singapore nationality result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Once your visa application has been approved, you'll be issued your Visa upon arrival at the airport or border.
